name: chromaglass
description: Psychedelic audio-reactive liquid light show visualizer
author: James Higgins

scripts.update: git pull origin main && npm install && npm run build
scripts.ship: npm run update && npm run deploy && npm run remote
scripts.show: npm run update && npm run remote
scripts.gallery: npm run build && esbuild scripts/gallery.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --log-level=warning --external:playwright --outfile=node_modules/.cache/gallery.mjs && node node_modules/.cache/gallery.mjs
